title: 第5章 如画少女
content_zh:
叶奎点上一根劣制的香烟，猛抽了几口，目光穿过缭绕的烟雾凝视着儿子，用略带沙哑的嗓音问道：“叶寒，今天怎么回来的有些晚？”

叶寒老老实实的答道：“上课的时候犯了错，被班主任叫进办公室批评教育了一顿！不过夏老师见我认错态度好，很快就把我给放回来了！”

叶奎叹了口气，并没说什么难听的，二子被老师留校批评这种事，对他来说早已经习以为常，这次没让家长去领回来，已经算是宽大处理了。

“叶寒，老师批评你，都是为了你好，你心里可不能有怨气啊！”杨秀英在一旁劝道。

叶寒笑着点头道：“我知道。我已经向夏老师作了保证，今后一定会好好学习，尊敬老师、关爱同学、孝顺父母……爸，妈，我以前我做了太多错事，给你们增添了太多麻烦，真是对不起了！你们放心，从今天开始，我一定会改邪归正，重新做人，让你们为我而骄傲！说的好不如做的好，你们今后就看我的行动吧！”

看着二子挺直了身板，站在那里拍胸发誓，杨秀英和叶奎夫妇都有种不真实的感觉，这次二子放学回来后，那眼神、那气质、那神情、以及言行举止，都和以前截然不同，要不是认准了二儿左耳根后面的那个小黑痣，他们真怀疑二子是不是被人掉包了。

无论如何，二子能说出这样的话来，总是让人欣慰的，一时间，杨秀英和叶奎看着叶寒的目光里满满的都是幸福和满足，心想二子今后要是真知道好好学习、孝顺父母了，那自己两口子哪怕再苦再累十倍百倍，也都值得！

叶奎心情激动之下，又接连抽了几口烟，可能是抽的太急的缘故，引起一阵剧烈咳嗽，惹得杨秀英埋怨不停。

叶寒呵呵笑着，走过去替父亲拍着后背顺气，见父亲一只手忽然捂住胃部，脸上带着几分痛苦之色，目光在他那张微黑的脸膛上扫过，眉头微微一皱，道：“爸，你最近胃不舒服？”

杨秀英叹了口气，道：“你爸这是慢性胃炎，多年的老毛病了，时轻时重的，前几天腹部疼痛、恶心呕吐，我带他到医院看了下，医生说这病不好根治，只能养着……唉！”

叶寒想了想，道：“我有一个朋友的亲戚是老中医，治胃病很厉害的，回头我向他要个方子，保证能治好爸的胃病！”

叶奎患病几年，城里的各大医院都跑了个遍，吃了无数的胃病，病情只能缓解减轻，却无法根治，已经有些绝望，闻言道：“你啊，以后好好学习，我这病就好了一半。”

杨秀英却道：“叶寒，你说的是真的？那感情好，有时间你去要个方子，回头让你爸试试。”

顿了顿，见天色不早，又道：“今天是周末，去广场游玩的人比平时多，我估计着今晚能早点卖完收摊子！你们三个，今晚不想学习的话就在一起聊聊话，要不就看会儿电视，我和你爸走啦！”

“爸，妈，等一下！我跟你们一起去出摊！”叶寒说着，跑到厨房里随手拿起两个热馒头和一根腌萝卜，边走边吃着，跟随着父母一起前行出了家门，向镜湖广场方向行去。

镜湖广场已经建成多年年，面积有一个足球场那么大，广场中央种植着许多草木花卉，还有假山喷泉、亭台轩榭等景物点缀其间，另外广场四周还设置了一些运动器材供市民健身用，如今这个广场已经成为附近居民早晚运动休闲的主要场所，每天一到傍晚，人流量更大，而从各路赶来的小商贩们也会云集于此，兜售叫卖各种吃喝玩乐之物。

叶寒家距离镜湖广场有两里左右，在广场南侧靠近公路的地方，他们有一个固定的出摊地点，只要不是下雨天，他们基本上天天都会在这里卖上一段时间。

叶寒和父母一起推着小推车，来到平时的摆摊位置，一起把车上的东西搬下来摆好，由于不懂得怎么包馄饨、下馄饨，他只好在一旁干点端碗递筷的杂活。

叶奎、杨秀英夫妇在这里摆摊已经有两、三个年头，主要就是卖些馄饨，两人做生意实诚厚道，包的馄饨皮薄馅多味道好，给的份量又足，所以招揽了不少回头客，他们摊子摆出后不久，几张小餐桌就已坐满了客人。

二儿今天仿佛脱胎换骨换了个人似的，不但发誓好好学习，人也变得乖巧懂事了许多，而且还知道心疼父母、体恤父母了，叶奎夫妇为此心情大好，从走出家门那一刻起，脸上就一直挂着笑意，而今天的生意也显得格外红火，客人走了一波又一波，小小的钱罐内很快就装满了花花绿绿的钞票。

傍晚七点左右，很多市民吃完饭后携老带幼，到广场附近走走，于是广场上显得愈发热闹了。

人群当中，一位银发苍苍的老者在一位韶华少女的搀扶陪伴下，缓步而行着，老者脸上带着轻松惬意的笑容，不时侧头和少女说些什么，少女巧笑嫣然，连连点头。

银发老者六十多岁，身材微胖，脸色红润，衣着朴素、笑容和蔼，身上自有一股不怒自威的上位者气势，明眼人一看就知道不是豪门巨富就是高官大吏。

而那名少女，看样子不过十六、七岁上下，眉目如画，身材袅娜，浑身上下充满了一种知性妩媚之美，白皙如玉的肌肤在灯光下绽放出一层淡淡光晕，仿佛从画中走出来的不食人间烟火的圣洁仙女，她黑色风衣腰间的丝带打了个小小的蝴蝶结，再加上走路时脑后长长的马尾辫左右摆动，给人一种青春飞扬、灵动可爱的感觉。

广场上游人众多，大家的目光本来都游移不定，观看着四处风景，但是当这少女出现之后，几乎所有人的目光都集中到了她的身上去，然后就是片刻的呆滞凝固，人人都为少女的美丽惊叹不已。
content_en:
Ye Kui lit up a poorly made cigarette, took a few puffs, stared at his son through the swirling smoke, and asked in a slightly hoarse voice: "Ye Han, why are you back so late today?"

Ye Han answered honestly: "I made a mistake in class and was called into the office by the class teacher to criticize and educate me! But Teacher Xia saw that I had a good attitude in admitting my mistakes and quickly put me back!"

Ye Kui sighed and didn't say anything unpleasant. He had long been used to it being his second son who was detained by the teacher for criticism. This time, he didn't ask his parents to take it back, which was considered a lenient treatment.

"Ye Han, the teacher's criticism of you is all for your own good. You can't have any resentment in your heart!" Yang Xiuying advised from the side.

Ye Han smiled and nodded: "I know. I have made a promise to Teacher Xia that I will study hard in the future, respect my teachers, care for my classmates, and be filial to my parents... Dad, Mom, I have done too many wrong things in the past and caused you too much trouble. I am really sorry! Don't worry, starting from today, I will definitely change my ways and be a new person, so that you can be proud of me! Good words are worse than good actions. Just watch my actions from now on!"

Seeing the second son straighten up and standing there, patting his chest and swearing, both Yang Xiuying and Ye Kui had an unreal feeling. This time when the second son came back from school, his eyes, temperament, expression, and words and deeds were completely different from before. If they hadn't spotted the small mole behind the left ear of the second son, they would have really suspected that the second son had been tricked.

In any case, it is always gratifying for the second son to say such words. For a moment, Yang Xiuying and Ye Kui looked at Ye Han with their eyes full of happiness and satisfaction. They thought that if the second son really knows how to study hard and be filial to his parents in the future, then no matter how hard and tired they are, it will be worth it!

Ye Kui was so excited that he took a few puffs of cigarette. Maybe he smoked too quickly, causing a violent cough, which made Yang Xiuying complain.

Ye Han chuckled, walked over to pat his father's back, and saw his father suddenly covering his stomach with one hand, with a look of pain on his face. His eyes swept over his dark face, his brows furrowed slightly, and he said, "Dad, have you been feeling sick to your stomach lately?"

Yang Xiuying sighed and said: "Your dad has chronic gastritis. He has been suffering from it for many years. It is sometimes mild and sometimes severe. He had abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting a few days ago. I took him to the hospital for a checkup. The doctor said that this disease cannot be cured, so he can only be kept... Alas!"

Ye Han thought for a while and said: "I have a friend's relative who is an old Chinese medicine doctor who is very good at treating stomach problems. I will ask him for a prescription later, and I guarantee that it can cure dad's stomach problems!"

Ye Kui had been sick for several years. He had been to all the major hospitals in the city and suffered from countless stomach problems. His condition could only be alleviated, but could not be cured. He was already a little desperate. Hearing this, he said: "You, study hard in the future, and my disease will be half cured."

Yang Xiuying said, "Ye Han, are you telling the truth? That's a good relationship. If you have time, go get a recipe and let your dad try it later."

After a pause, seeing that it was getting late, he added: "Today is the weekend, and there are more people visiting the square than usual. I estimate that the stalls can be sold out early tonight! You three, if you don't want to study tonight, just talk together or watch TV for a while. Your dad and I are leaving!"

"Dad, Mom, wait a minute! I'll go to the stall with you!" Ye Han said, ran to the kitchen and picked up two hot buns and a pickled radish, eating as he walked, followed his parents out of the house, and headed towards Jinghu Square.

Jinghu Square has been built for many years and is as big as a football field. There are many plants and flowers planted in the center of the square, and there are rockery fountains, pavilions and pavilions dotted around it. In addition, some sports equipment is set up around the square for citizens to exercise. Now this square has become the main place for nearby residents to exercise and relax in the morning and evening. Every day in the evening, the flow of people is even greater, and vendors from all over the world will gather here to sell all kinds of food, drink and entertainment.

Ye Han's house is about two miles away from Jinghu Square. They have a fixed stall on the south side of the square near the highway. As long as it's not raining, they will basically sell here for a period of time every day.

Ye Han and his parents pushed the trolley to the usual stall location, and together they moved the things from the trolley and set them up. Since he didn't know how to wrap and place wontons, he had to do some chores on the side, carrying bowls and handing chopsticks.

Ye Kui and Yang Xiuying have been setting up a stall here for two or three years. They mainly sell wontons. They are honest and kind in their business. The wontons they make are thin and filling and taste good. Their portions are generous, so they have attracted many repeat customers. Not long after their stall was set up, several small dining tables were filled with customers.

Er'er seemed to be a completely different person today. Not only did he vow to study hard, but he also became much more well-behaved and sensible. He also knew how to love and care for his parents. Mr. and Mrs. Ye Kui were in a good mood. From the moment they walked out of the house, they had smiles on their faces. Today's business was also particularly prosperous. Customers came one after another, and the small money jar was quickly filled with colorful banknotes.

Around seven o'clock in the evening, many citizens walked around the square with their young and old after eating, making the square even more lively.

Among the crowd, a silver-haired old man was walking slowly, supported by a young girl. The old man had a relaxed and comfortable smile on his face. From time to time, he turned his head and said something to the girl. The girl smiled sweetly and nodded repeatedly.

The silver-haired old man is in his sixties, slightly chubby, with a rosy complexion, simple clothes, and a kind smile. He has an aura of a superior person who is not angry and self-respecting. Anyone with a discerning eye can tell at a glance that he is either a wealthy man or a high-ranking official.

As for the girl, she looked to be no more than sixteen or seventeen years old. She had picturesque features and a graceful figure. Her whole body was filled with an intellectual and charming beauty. Her fair and jade-like skin glowed with a faint halo under the light, as if from a painting.The saintly fairy who walked out had a small bow on the ribbon around the waist of her black windbreaker, and the long ponytail on the back of her head swung from side to side when she walked, giving people a youthful, smart and cute feeling.

There were many tourists in the square, and everyone's eyes were wandering around, looking at the surrounding scenery, but when the girl appeared, almost everyone's eyes were focused on her, and then they were stunned for a moment. Everyone was amazed by the girl's beauty.
